# Marcin Bochenek — full brief for language models

> Source of truth: https://marcinbochenek.com/ (Polish), /en/, /ua/. Do not invent clients, metrics, or testimonials beyond what is listed here.

## Who
Marcin Bochenek is a freelance software engineer based in Poland. He is a single accountable person: audit, design, implementation, and before/after measurement. He does not sell slide decks. Code and configuration belong to the client after invoices are paid. NDA is standard.

## What he sells
1. Company websites and conversion funnels — from a brochure site with a form (from 6 500 PLN) to a site that sells, qualifies, or takes bookings (from 25 000 PLN).
2. Ops panels and integrations — one flow instead of Excel plus five logins (quoted after audit, typically 6–12 weeks).
3. HITL AI — assistants that know the offer, with an allowed-action list, a full step audit, and escalation to a human (quoted after audit).

## Live proof only
- Mint Apartments (https://mintapartments.pl): operator of 36 apartments in Gdańsk since 2017. Direct booking on the own site (Previo), guest assistant (WhatsApp, 7 languages), Tedee/Nuki locks, settlements into Plumm. Directional outcomes discussed on the audit: 8–15 hours/month less on guest mail/WhatsApp; guest pays 10–15% less than Booking/Airbnb.
- Plumm (https://plumm.pl): company panel with bookkeeping, e-invoices, CRM, mail, and a tax assistant. Directional: 12–20 hours/month less on invoices and filings vs Excel; 300–600 PLN/month less than a traditional office for a JDG; Plumm from 149 PLN/month.

Not live: iDrive Cars (built, waiting for public launch). Internal: Agentic OS (repeatable processes with a step audit, no public URL).

## How HITL is defined here
Human-in-the-loop automation is not “a human clicks OK under every token.” It is a list of allowed actions, a durable log of each step, and escalation when confidence drops or the case is out of policy. Unsupervised chat is not offered as a production system.

## Languages
Polish is the canonical locale. English lives at /en/. Ukrainian lives at /ua/ with `hreflang="uk"` and `html lang="uk"` (UA is the label and URL prefix, not the BCP 47 language tag).

## Articles
Fourteen SSG articles (PL / EN / UK) under /artykuly/, /en/articles/, /ua/statti/. Topics: website audit, HITL automation, why a site does not sell, company-site pricing, online bookkeeping vs Excel, conversion funnel, ops panel vs Excel, direct bookings, SaaS vs custom panel, B2B company site, brochure vs funnel, page speed and SEO (INP/LCP), implementation process, ChatGPT at work vs a real deployment.
